selection_basis: The first four actionable records emitted by the canonical review queue under data/claim-cleanup-policy.json before any batch-one rewrite was applied.

observed_initial_queue.blocked_reason: The higher-priority preview consisted of sensitive or restricted records requiring actual-source and safety review rather than automatic practical rewriting.

guardrail: This batch records editorial rewrites, not scientific review. No entry is promoted to reviewed and no source is added merely to preserve inherited wording.

entries.decision: Remove fabricated pilot, percentage, mechanism and retention claims. Preserve only a phrase-to-next-action prompt with explicit limits against romanticizing hardship or overriding a boundary.

Remove invented comprehension, recall and lab statistics. Preserve a neutral analogy protocol built around mapping, an explicit boundary and listener paraphrase. Suppress the inherited NLP method label.

Remove unsupported detail multipliers, sample claims and fabricated observations. Preserve a permission-based recent-event interview with sequential questions, uncertainty labels and summary correction.
Remove fabricated trials, cohort outcomes, response-rate claims and arbitrary quotas. Preserve a focused feedback request followed by an explicit accept, test, discuss, defer or reject decision.
